messages:
emma: Heads up — my flight to SFO just got delayed. I won't be online reliably from ~02:00–08:00 UTC. Can someone take primary for that slot? I can try to shadow from phone but prefer not to be primary.

raj: I can pick up primary from 02:00–06:00 UTC if that helps. I have a meeting at 06:15 that might cut into the tail — can we do a handoff at 05:50 UTC? @emma does that cover the window?

emma: @raj that would help a ton, thank you. I was originally primary until 08:00 so we still need 06:00–08:00 covered. If @ben or @sara can extend, otherwise I can try to do 06:00–08:00 as backup but wifi may be flaky.

ben: I can stretch to 08:00 UTC if needed. I'm in EST so it'll be late but doable. I'll take primary 06:00–08:00.

emma: Awesome — plan: @raj primary 02:00–05:50 (handoff check at 05:50), @ben primary 05:50–08:00. I'll mark myself as secondary/backup for 02:00–08:00 and try to shadow.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Reminder: Pager escalation policy — primary gets P1 pages first, then secondary after 2 minutes, then engineering lead. Make sure runbook link is handy: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/production-api

raj: Quick question — any ongoing incidents or tenant-facing issues right now? I want context before taking over.

emma: Nothing active. We had a minor embed-cache spike last night but it's stabilized. Key things to check on takeover:
- traces: https://observability/redwood/traces?service=inference-runtime
- tokens/sec and avg latency on console route: /v1/generate
- Redis KV cache hit rate

ben: Can someone paste the handoff checklist snippet? I don't want to miss anything during the 05:50 swap.

emma: Copying checklist below — this is what I use for quick handoffs:
```
Handoff checklist:
1) Confirm primary/secondary in PagerDuty + Slack (update description)
2) Check recent alerts (sentry + metrics) for regressions
3) Run quick smoke: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":5}'
4) Validate model pool health (console -> Dedicated -> Pools)
5) Post in #eng-oncall when swap complete with timestamp
```

sara: :thumbsup: also ping infra if you see GPU OOM trends — Jake from eng-infra is usually awake for that window.

lee: I'll be standby for escalation 02:00–08:00 in case both primary and secondary are sticky. If any P0 hits, escalate to me after the oncall-bot timer.

raj: Got it. I'll take primary and follow the checklist. I'll post when I finish initial checks (will do a smoke and confirm model pool health).

emma: Thank you all. I'll update the rotation calendar and set a Slack status + short note in PagerDuty with swap details. Leaving the handoff note here for audit.

raj: Initial checks done (02:03 UTC): smoke request succeeded, latency looks normal (p50 ~120ms), no alerts on Sentry for last 30min. Taking primary.

ben: Acknowledged — will be ready to pick at 05:50 UTC. 

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Handoff record created: primary change 02:03 UTC (emma -> raj). Runbook attached: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/production-api#handoff-procedures

emma: Everything noted. If anything spikes, @lee is standby. Thanks team — I'll try to stay reachable but appreciate the cover.
